backend/main.mo: Actor defines core backend state and types for profiles, pairing, schedules, filters, activity, locations, audit logs, login events, and battery status with authorization and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Report listing feature implementations with associated file paths, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short descriptions summarizing behavior and purpose of frontend files and components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining base theme variables for light and dark modes and applying global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document loading the React app root and main module with metadata and icons.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app name, icons, colors, start URL, and display settings.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handling caching, fetch fallback, and queued location update syncing with background sync events.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication, profile setup, admin gate, login recording, presence heartbeat, battery reporting, and routing to role-specific dashboards.
frontend/src/components/account/AccountD: Dropdown showing user name and role with actions to change photo, change password, view policies, or delete account, opening corresponding dialogs.
frontend/src/components/account/ChangePa: Dialog explaining external password management and linking to Internet Identity for password changes.
frontend/src/components/account/ChangePr: Dialog for selecting, previewing, uploading, or removing a profile photo with validation and progress handling.
frontend/src/components/account/DeleteAc: Confirmation dialog requiring typing DELETE before executing an account deletion mutation.
frontend/src/components/account/UserAvat: Avatar component showing a user's photo or initials with size options.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccountsTa: Empty file placeholder for an admin accounts table component.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminBatte: Admin panel listing device battery statuses with icons, colors, timestamps, and loading states.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLogin: Admin analytics panel displaying login counts by day, month, or year with input fields and refresh controls.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminOverv: Displays admin dashboard cards showing parent/child counts and metrics with loading skeletons and navigation actions.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPassw: Implements password verification and password change UI for admin access with validation and allowlist checks.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminSideb: Renders the admin sidebar navigation listing sections and highlighting the active one.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminUsers: Shows a table of parent or child users with loading states and empty-state handling.
frontend/src/components/admin/Aggregated: Displays aggregated admin metrics in a grid of statistic cards with icons and loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/alerts/AlertsPan: Shows a child's screen‑time usage alerts, over‑limit warning, and a form to request more time.
Displays a parent's view of a child’s daily usage alerts with over‑limit or within‑limit status.
frontend/src/components/audit/AuditLogTa: Displays a sortable audit log table for a child, mapping backend actions to labels and showing executor and timestamp.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with UI states, error handling, and query/admin state resets.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Provides a profile setup form with role selection, phone validation, and admin unlock/password verification before saving the profile.
frontend/src/components/child/ActivityHi: Fetches and displays a child's activity history in a sorted table with optional transparency labeling.
frontend/src/components/child/ChildCheck: Allows children to submit activities, share manual or live location, and manage live sharing status with validation and geolocation.
frontend/src/components/child/ConsentNot: Shows an alert explaining consent requirements for activity, location, or pairing actions with icons and localized text.
frontend/src/components/child/LocationHi: Lists a child's location history with sorting, tab-based limits, and links to view coordinates on Google Maps.
frontend/src/components/child/PairWithPa: Enables pairing a child with a parent using a code or phone workflow, handling validation, pending states, and backend pairing results.
frontend/src/components/filters/ContentF: UI for parents to edit a child’s content filter, including categories, allowlist, and blocklist, and saving updates via API hooks.
Displays a read‑only view of a child’s content filter, showing categories, allowlist, and blocklist with status badges.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSel: Dropdown for switching the app’s language using i18n state.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter: App footer showing copyright, links to policies, and a caffeine.ai credit link.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Top navigation bar with app branding, user menu, theme toggle, language selector, and policies button.
frontend/src/components/parent/ActivityV: Parent view showing a notice about voluntary data and a child’s activity history list with auto‑refresh.
frontend/src/components/parent/ChildSumm: Card summarizing a child’s recent activity and location counts with selection highlighting.
frontend/src/components/parent/LiveLocat: Displays latest shared location with timestamps, live‑sharing status, and a map link, handling loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/parent/LocationV: Tabbed interface for parents to view a child’s live map or location history with a transparency notice.
frontend/src/components/parent/PairingSe: UI component that generates and displays a pairing code, with copy-to-clipboard support and warning messaging.
frontend/src/components/parent/ParentPho: Allows parents to view, edit, validate, and save their phone number using profile queries and form controls.
frontend/src/components/schedule/Schedul: Provides an editable interface for setting daily screen time limits and time windows, with save actions tied to schedule queries.
Displays a child's configured daily limit and allowed time windows in a read-only schedule view.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminGate.ts: Stores a simple session flag indicating whether an admin gate has been passed, with helpers to set and clear it.
frontend/src/hooks/useBatteryReporting.t: Periodically reports device battery level to the backend when authenticated, throttled to a 5‑minute interval.
frontend/src/hooks/useI18n.ts: Thin wrapper returning the app’s i18n context for translations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook implementing Internet Identity login, persistence, and identity state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveLocationSharin: Hook that periodically captures geolocation, submits it, queues failures, and processes retries with visibility handling.
Sends periodic user heartbeat to backend and triggers extra updates on visibility change.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, admin data, and other backend interactions.
frontend/src/i18n/I18nProvider.tsx: Provides i18n context with language persistence, translation lookup, and parameter replacement.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Exports locale types, translation dictionaries, and supported locales.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/en.ts: English translation dictionary for all UI strings.
frontend/src/i18n/translations/pt-BR.ts: Brazilian Portuguese translation dictionary for all UI strings.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark navy theme variables and base element styling.
frontend/src/lib/leafletMarkerIcon.ts: Empty file reserved for Leaflet marker icon setup.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, QueryClient, Internet Identity, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard that switches between overview, user lists, analytics, and battery panels using a sidebar-driven section state.
frontend/src/pages/child/ChildHome.tsx: Child dashboard showing welcome info, supervision notice, pairing prompt, and tabbed views for check-in, history, schedule, filters, and alerts.
frontend/src/pages/parent/ParentDashboar: Parent dashboard with pairing management, child summaries, and tabs for monitoring activity, location, schedules, filters, audit logs, and alerts.
Modal page showing translated transparency and privacy policy sections with icons and scrollable content.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Registers a service worker and provides helpers for background and periodic sync support with status reporting.
frontend/src/utils/liveLocationCapabilit: Detects device and PWA capabilities for geolocation and background sync and returns a user-facing capability message.
frontend/src/utils/locationUpdateQueue.t: LocalStorage-backed queue for storing and retrying location updates with limits on size and retry count.
frontend/src/utils/phoneNumber.ts: Utility functions for normalizing, validating, formatting, and comparing phone numbers used in the app.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and removing them from hash-based routes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining content paths, custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Metadata describing the project’s admin dashboard overhaul, architectural notes, known issues, and feature requirements.
